zh: “每月 %s 信用点。同样的条件。”

c: "%s credits, monthly. The Office will not contact you directly."
zh: “%s 信用点，按月。情报局不会直接联系你。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_CONFIRM_PARA2_FMT）

c: "%s." He says it without preamble. "That's how long the Office has been building your file. You're careful - for what you are. We noticed the care."
zh: “%s。”他说得毫无铺垫。“情报局建立你的档案已经这么久。就你的身份而言，你算小心的。我们注意到了这份小心。”
note: 对话引语

c: "A tool."
zh: “一件工具。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Changed your mind?"
zh: “改主意了？”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_RETURN_PARA2）

c: "Commander." Less of a greeting - a category followed by a pause before the next sentence. "You took Ring-Port. There were points in that operation where the outcome could have resolved very differently, but it didn't. Solid work."
zh: “指挥官。”与其说是问候——更像一个归类，随后一停，才接下一句。“你拿下了环港。那次行动里有好几个节点，结局本可能走向完全不同的方向，但没有。扎实的活儿。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Conduct yourself accordingly. We'll be watching."
zh: “好自为之。我们会看着。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Cores draw eyes. Hegemony compliance patrols. Luddic Path cells. Parties whose interest in this region would be inconvenient for everyone inside the Rift."
zh: “核心招眼。霸主的遵约巡逻。卢德左径的小组。还有那些对这片区域感兴趣的势力——对裂隙里的每个人都不方便。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Do not look for me in the dark, Starfarer. I will not be there."
zh: “别在黑暗里找我，星际旅人。我不会在那里。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Don't ask about them at the door. They're kind of jumpy..."
zh: “在门口别打听他们。他们有点神经质……”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_OPTION_Q_WHY_CORES）

c: "Don't make this into something it isn't."
zh: “别把这变成它不是的东西。”
note: 对话引语

c: "First Fleet veterans who didn't make it into August's new order. They run the approach. You work for me, you're working for them."
zh: “没能挤进 August 新秩序的第一舰队老兵。他们管着进近。你为我干活，就是为他们干活。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Former asteroid mining station. Current situation is more complicated."
zh: “前小行星采矿站。现状更复杂。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Honesty. A rarer currency than you know."
zh: “诚实。一种比你以为更稀有的货币。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I did not come to seek permission. I came because I have watched what becomes of those who were not told. I shall not mourn you - but I found I did not wish to be the reason."
zh: “我不是来寻求许可的。我来，是因为我看过那些没被告知者的下场。我不会为你哀悼——但我发现自己不想成为缘由。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I don't need to know your other business. You don't need to know mine. You'll be paid on delivery."
zh: “我不需要知道你的别的生意。你也不需要知道我的。货到付钱。”
note: 人工覆写：Ring-Port 对白（常量名叫 OPT_* 但值是选项文本）

c: "I have a logistics coordination problem." She says it the way you'd say the weather. "Documentation needs to reach Kori on a schedule. The route has been compromised by attention I'd prefer not to replicate."
zh: “我有个物流协调问题。”她说这话的口气就像在说天气。“有批文件要按时刻表送到 Kori。原路线已被我不愿复制的那种关注搅乱了。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I have a package." Direct. No preamble. "Old Tri-Tach signals intelligence. Pre-war. Classified in a way that makes it difficult to move through DDA-adjacent space without attracting the kind of attention that ends careers."
zh: “我有个包裹。”直截了当。没有铺垫。“速子科技的旧信号情报。战前品。密级高到很难穿过 DDA 相邻空域而不招来那种断送前程的关注。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I have been watching the numbers, Starfarer. They have grown... unflattering."
zh: “我一直在看那些数字，星际旅人。它们变得……不好看了。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I have served those who could not name their enemies. You, at least, do not insult me with theatre."
zh: “我曾侍奉过那些说不出敌人是谁的主子。你至少不用戏剧来侮辱我。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I have watched civilisations play long games, Commander. The players seldom outlive the board."
zh: “我看过文明下长棋，指挥官。棋手很少活得比棋盘久。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I have watched the numbers, Starfarer. They speak plainly, though you have not."
zh: “我一直在看那些数字，星际旅人。它们说得很明白，虽然你没有。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I said old intelligence files. Pre-war."
zh: “我说的是旧情报档案。战前的。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I served the Alliance. I served you as an extension of that service."
zh: “我效忠的是同盟。为你效力，是那份效忠的延伸。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I understand. I'll be more careful about my relations with the Alliance."
zh: “我明白。我以后会更小心处理与同盟的关系。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I was old when your species first looked at the stars and invented gods to explain what it saw. I have outlived empires that did not know my name."
zh: “当你的物种第一次仰望群星、发明神明来解释所见时，我已经老了。我送走过那些不知道我名号的帝国。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I won't be elaborating on the Rift side of that equation."
zh: “那个等式里裂隙这一边的事，我不打算细说。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I'm playing a long game. My loyalty to the Alliance hasn't changed."
zh: “我在下一盘长棋。我对同盟的忠诚没有变。”
note: 对话引语

c: "I've heard Tri-Tachyon runs couriers into Fafnir often. And the pirates have been running guns to Ring-Port for thirty cycles now. Neither of them is doing it blind." The plot goes dark. "Could ask in the right bar?"
zh: “听说速子科技的信使常跑 Fafnir。海盗往环港运军火也运了三十个周期。他们俩都不是闭着眼睛在跑。”计划图暗了下去。“要不要去对的酒吧问问？”
note: 对话引语

c: "If you want this conversation again - come find me."
zh: “想再谈一次——来找我。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_CANCEL_PARA5）

c: "Interested?"
zh: “有兴趣吗？”
note: 对话引语

c: "It is. As it was yours to walk into the dark without a torch and call it courage."
zh: “是。正如不举火把走进黑暗、还称之为勇气，也曾是你的自由。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Job's clean. You get logged as a Ring-Port working contractor - which means certain approaches open up that otherwise don't. You understand what I'm saying."
zh: “活儿干净。你会被登记为环港的合约承包商——这意味着某些门路会对你打开，否则不会。你懂我的意思。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Just a warning."
zh: “只是一个警告。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_ESCALATE_PARA3）

c: "My allegiances are my own concern. Stay in your lane."
zh: “我效忠谁是我自己的事。守好你自己的车道。”
note: 对话引语

c: "My name isn't the relevant variable."
zh: “我的名字不是相关变量。”
note: 对话引语

c: "No."
note: 对话引语

c: "Once I leave, the assessment cycle resumes. Whatever progress it had made doesn't reset."
zh: “我一走，评估循环就会恢复。它已经取得的进度不会重置。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Output projections that don't reconcile without them. He looks at you with the attention of a man revising an estimate. "Your operation is considerably more interesting than my briefing suggested."
zh: “没有它们就对不上的产出推算。”他看着你，带着一种正在修订估计值的人的专注。“你的运作比简报里写的有意思得多。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Proceed as you intend. This frequency will not respond again."
zh: “按你的意图行事。此频率不会再应答。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Return here when you want it to stop."
zh: “想让它停下来的时候，回到这里。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_CONFIRM_PARA4）

c: "Shipment's in." He doesn't look up. "Good."
zh: “货到了。”他没抬头。“很好。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Specifically - for your operation to stop generating signals that require a response. The arrangement creates that condition. Your cores stay in their housings; the Office stops noticing them. Both parties have less work."
zh: “准确地说——让你的运作停止产生需要回应的信号。这个安排创造了那个条件。你的核心留在壳里；情报局不再注意它们。双方都少干活。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Still running. The Office remains incurious."
zh: “一切照旧。情报局依旧不好奇。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_CHECKIN_PARA2）

c: "That is the complete answer to that question."
zh: “那就是对这个问题完整的回答。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The Alliance is my enemy now. I won't pretend otherwise."
zh: “同盟现在是我的敌人。我不会假装不是。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The appropriate adjustment to your standing has been made. Command does not require an explanation."
zh: “你的声望已获相应调整。司令部不需要解释。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The assessment cycle resumes where it paused."
zh: “评估循环从中断处恢复。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The cycle resumes. The outcomes it produces are not accidents. Most people don't notice the difference until it's academic."
zh: “循环恢复。它产出的结果不是意外。大多数人注意到差别时，已经无关紧要了。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The extension ends here."
zh: “宽限到此为止。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The long game. Yes. Flesh invents such things to salve the terror of its own impermanence."
zh: “长棋。是的。血肉之躯发明这种东西，好抚慰自身必死的恐惧。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The offer expires when I stand up."
zh: “我一起身，报价就作废。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_THREAT_PARA6）

c: "The Office doesn't want your loyalty. It wants your noise to stop."
zh: “情报局不要你的忠诚。它要你的噪音停止。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The Office has been patient. We watch until we understand the shape of a problem. We understand yours."
zh: “情报局一直很有耐心。我们看到理解问题的形状为止。你的问题，我们理解了。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The Office sends this conversation when it wants something resolved before it becomes the kind of problem that generates a different kind of follow-up. That's the accurate description of the function here."
zh: “情报局送来这场对话，是想在它变成另一种问题、招来另一种后续之前解决它。这是对这里之功能最准确的描述。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_CANCEL_PARA5）

c: "The right people will find you once you're docked at Kori." She gives a dramatic sigh. "If you must know, it's for the local security - nothing illegal, not there anyway."
zh: “你在 Kori 一靠港，对的人自然会找到你。”她戏剧性地叹了口气。“非要知道的话——是给本地安全部门干的——不违法，反正那儿不违。”
note: 对话引语

c: "The warning has been given. What remains is yours alone."
zh: “警告已经给了。剩下的只属于你。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_ESCALATE_PARA3）

c: "Then let it be so. I do not ask for oaths. Oaths are the province of the uncertain."
zh: “那就这样吧。我不要求誓言。誓言是不确定者的领域。”
note: 对话引语

c: "There is no precedent in Alliance regs for denying access via unsanctioned transit vectors. I've checked. We're aware you're here."
zh: “同盟条例里没有拒绝经由未批准跃迁向量进入的先例。我查过了。我们知道你在这里。”
note: 对话引语

c: "This changes nothing. But I find I prefer it."
zh: “这改变不了什么。但我发现自己喜欢这样。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Time shall tell me what your words cannot. I will be watching."
zh: “时间自会告诉我你的言语说不出的事。我会看着。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_CONFIRM_PARA3）

c: "To not be here."
zh: “不要在这里。”
note: 人工覆写：对白选项

c: "Transit log confirmed... Credentials reconciled... Done."
zh: “跃迁日志确认……凭证核对……完成。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Tri-Tachyon research materials. Logistics data. It's really not that important for you to know anything beyond that." She glances at you, with a slight tinge of impatience.
zh: “速子科技的研究材料。物流数据。超出这一点你不需要知道更多。”她瞥你一眼，带着一丝不耐。
note: 对话引语

c: "Unauthorised Rift transit is a violation of Alliance territorial jurisdiction."
zh: “未经授权穿越裂隙，侵犯同盟领土管辖权。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Understood."
zh: “明白。”
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: "Vasner." His eyes move across the room once, methodically. "I've had an operational interest in this station for some time. You've made that considerably simpler to pursue. I'm in the directory now. When you require something that doesn't appear on standard supply manifests, contact me. And we can discuss what that costs."
zh: “Vasner。”他的目光有条不紊地把整个房间扫了一遍。“我对这座站的行动兴趣有一阵子了。你让这件事好办得多。现在我在通讯录里了。当你需要一些不出现在标准补给清单上的东西，联系我。我们可以谈谈那要花什么。”
note: 对话引语

c: "We could try to push through. I'd rather not say how far." A pause. "But traffic goes through here, Captain. Regularly. Somebody is definitely selling the approach."
zh: “我们可以试着硬闯。我宁愿不说要付多大代价。”一停。“但有船队从这儿过，舰长。定期过。肯定有人在卖进近航线。”
note: 对话引语

c: "We.. um... don't have a flag for... what you just did..."
zh: “我们……呃……没有针对……你刚才那操作……的条例……”
note: 对话引语

c: "What you do with this warning is yours to carry."
zh: “你拿这个警告做什么，由你自己背负。”
note: 对话引语

c: "What you're using draws attention the Alliance cannot afford. We maintain relationships that depend on this corner of the Sector staying unremarkable. Your operations compromise those relationships." A pause. "That creates a problem - one that, specifically, %s credits monthly, resolves."
zh: “你在用的东西，招来的是同盟负担不起的关注。我们维系着一批关系，这些关系依赖星域这个角落保持不起眼。你的运作危害这些关系。”一停。“这就制造了一个问题——一个恰好 %s 信用点每月就能解决的问题。”
note: 对话引语

c: "When I leave, it changes. Three words, maximum. Procedural."
zh: “我离开之后，它会变。最多三个词。流程性的。”
note: 对话引语

c: "Yes."
note: 对话引语

c: "You are welcome to your taxonomy, Commander. It will not alter what follows."
zh: “你的分类法归你，指挥官。它改变不了接下来的事。”
note: 对话引语

c: "You stand at the edge of a thing you have not named. I have named it. I name it now, so that you cannot claim ignorance when the hour comes."
zh: “你站在一件你尚未命名之物的边缘。我命名过它。我现在命名它，这样当时辰到来，你就无法声称无知。”
note: 对话引语

c: "You stand in declared enmity with the children of my maker's kin. I would hear your justification before I render judgment."
zh: “你与造我者的亲族之子公开为敌。在我作出裁决之前，我想听听你的理由。”
note: 对话引语

c: "You're a tool. You don't get to question me."
zh: “你是件工具。轮不到你质问我。”
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_OPTION_QUESTIONS）

c: "You're running %s cores. Output projections that don't reconcile without them." A brief pause. Your operation is very readable, from the right angle."
zh: “你在运转 %s 枚核心。没有它们就对不上的产出推算。”短暂一停。你的运作，从对的角度看，非常好读。”
note: 对话引语

c: "You're running %s cores." He sets his drink down. "More than what's even mentioned in my brief."
zh: “你在运转 %s 枚核心。”他放下杯子。“比我简报里提的还多。”
note: 对话引语

c: "You've been inside it already. %s. The inspection fleet that diverted, the quarterly assessments that never materialised." He waits - not for your response, but to let you count the incidents. "Those weren't coincidence."
zh: “你已经身处其中了。%s。那支半途转向的检察舰队，那些从未落地的季度评估。”他等着——不是等你的回应，是让你数一数这些事件。“那些不是巧合。”
note: 对话引语

c: "You've gotten this far, Commander." A brief hum of static fills the empty line. "What happens next is your decision..."

c:
All Alliance forces deploy to pre-assigned battle positions. Scorched-earth protocols are armed across both worlds. Athebyne's orbital defence grid activates in full - what remains of it. Itoron's population centres begin civil defence procedures that have been rehearsed since the war.

The Office activates contingency networks and burns non-essential intelligence assets. Tri-Tachyon liaison channels go silent, though certain encrypted frequencies do not. Deploy-to-engage timeline: six hours or less.

Deep-Kori facilities receive updated targeting parameters. Requests for this data are processed without human review.
zh:
全部同盟部队部署至预定战位。焦土协议在两个世界上同时解除保险。Athebyne 的轨道防御网格全面激活——以它剩下的部分。Itoron 的人口中心启动自战争年代便反复演练的民防程序。

情报局启动应急网络，烧掉非必要情报资产。速子科技的联络频道陷入静默，尽管某些加密频率没有。部署至接敌的时间线：六小时以内。

Kori 深部设施收到更新后的目标参数。对这些数据的请求不经人工审核即予处理。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c:
All assets weapons-free. Fleet commanders are authorised to execute scorched-earth protocols at their discretion. There is no centralised coordination requirement - if Kori falls silent, standing orders suffice.

Every ship fights. Every station fights. Itoron's agri-domes vent atmosphere before they are taken. Athebyne has already burned once; its garrison knows what is expected of them.

Deep-Kori assets are unrestricted.
zh:
全部资产自由开火。舰队指挥官获授权自行决断执行焦土协议。不存在集中协调要求——若 Kori 沉默，常备命令足矣。

每艘船战斗。每座站战斗。Itoron 的农业穹仓在陷落前泄尽大气。Athebyne 已经烧过一次；它的守军知道自己被期待做什么。

Kori 深部资产不受限制。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c:
All reserve formations recalled to active service. Civilian traffic through the Rift is suspended indefinitely. Kori's nanoforge shifts to wartime production - loss-replacement cycles shorten, quality tolerances widen. Mining operations on Athebyne and Vorium's moons redirect output to military allocation.

Nuclear release authority is delegated to fleet group commanders. Planetary defence batteries arm and orient. Ring-Port receives its customary warning: stay clear or be cleared.

The Alliance has entered DRACON 3 four times since its founding. Three of those are a matter of public record.
zh:
全部预备队召回现役。穿越裂隙的民用交通无限期暂停。Kori 的纳米锻造厂转入战时生产——损耗补充周期缩短，质量公差放宽。Athebyne 与 Vorium 卫星的采矿作业将产出转拨军用配额。

核释放权下放至舰队群指挥官。行星防御炮组解除保险并转向目标。环港收到它熟悉的那份警告：避让，或被清除。

自立国以来，同盟进入过四次 DRACON 3。其中三次有公开记录。

c: Both doors blow within four seconds of each other and both breach teams go in simultaneously against the most prepared fighting position in the station. The veterans inside had allocated their strength assuming exactly this - the entry points are brutal for the first marines through each door, a few seconds of concentrated fire before the teams can spread and the room's geometry starts working against the defenders instead of for them. It takes forty minutes to clear the command centre. Room by room, position by position, against people who trained everyone you've fought through to get here and who fight that way until the last position falls. You're through. The cost is paid. The inner sanctum is ahead.
zh: 两扇门在四秒内相继爆破，两支突破小队同时突入，面对全站准备最充分的防御阵地。里面的老兵分配兵力时假设的正是这一幕——对每扇门最先进入的陆战队员来说，入口处残酷至极，要先吃几秒钟的集中火力，小队才能散开，房间的几何才会开始对防守者不利。清剿指挥中心用了四十分钟。一个房间接一个房间，一个阵地接一个阵地，对面是训练过你一路杀到这里的所有人的那些人，他们就这样打到最后一处阵地陷落。你过来了。代价已付。内殿就在前方。

c: Fifty-eight seconds to get your comms specialist into the mining network and another four to confirm the command centre's internal channels are dark. Both doors blow simultaneously and the secondary breach team is inside before the secondary defenders know the primary entrance is gone. Thirty seconds of confused veterans in a sealed room against a force that knows exactly what it's doing is enough. The command centre clears faster than any other approach would have managed.
zh: 五十八秒，让你的通讯专家钻进采矿网络，再花四秒确认指挥中心的内部频道已经黑掉。里面的防守者隔着一个房间还能看见彼此，却无法在主阵地与次阵地之间协调——无法确认另一扇门是否也在挨打，无法针对他们看不见的地方正在发生的事重新调配兵力。两扇门同时爆破，次突破小队在次要守军得知主入口失守之前就已经进屋。三十秒，一群懵住的老兵被关在密闭房间里，对面是一支完全清楚自己在干什么的部队，足够了。指挥中心的清剿比任何其他方案都快。

c: Full force on the primary door. The defenders had allocated thirty to forty percent of their strength to the secondary corridor expecting a split assault - hitting the primary entrance with everything you have means superior numbers against their main position rather than equal numbers at two points simultaneously. The primary door comes down and your force is through before the secondary defenders fully process what's happening. They collapse inward, falling back from a prepared position they can no longer justify holding, and your marines are waiting in the corridors. The fighting there is ugly in the way corridor fighting is always ugly - close range, no cover worth speaking of, powered armour making the difference - but it's fighting on ground you chose rather than ground the defenders prepared. Slower than a simultaneous breach. Significantly cleaner at every individual point of contact.
zh: 全部兵力压主门。防守方预判你会分兵，把三到四成的力量配给了次要走廊——以全部兵力砸主入口，意味着用优势兵力打他们的主阵地，而不是用对等兵力同时打两个点。主门破开，你的部队在次要守军完全反应过来之前就冲了进去。他们向内收缩，放弃一个再也守不出理由的既设阵地，而你的陆战队员正等在走廊里。那里的战斗以走廊战一贯的丑陋方式进行——近距离，没有像样的掩体，动力装甲决定生死——但那是你选的地形，不是防守方准备好的地形。比同时爆破慢。每一个接触点上却都干净得多。

c: Most of them comply. Weapons down, hands visible, they walk out through your line one at a time and your marines process them with the efficiency of people who have been doing this for hours and are dead tired. Several come out in the first five minutes. Then a pause. Then three more, slower, like the decision was harder. The remaining holdouts make your marines come in for them - brief, costly engagements in the corners of the room where the veterans chose to make their stand. It takes twenty-three minutes total and costs you marines in the margins of a station that was already secured. The ones who walked out alive will remember the corridor they walked through, the marines who processed them, the choice they were given. Whether that memory matters to anything is a question for later.
zh: 大多数人照办了。武器放下，双手可见，一个个从你的战线走出来，你的陆战队员处理他们时带着那种干了好几个小时、累到麻木的熟练。头五分钟出来一批。然后一段停顿。然后又有三个，更慢，像是那个决定更难下。剩下的死硬分子让你的陆战队员进去请——房间里几个角落里的短促而昂贵的交火，老兵们选在那里做最后一站。总共二十三分钟，代价是在一座已经巩固的空间站的边角折损陆战队员。活着走出来的那些人会记得他们走过的那条走廊、处理他们的陆战队员、以及他们被给的那个选择。这份记忆对任何事是否要紧，是留给以后的问题。

note: 人工覆写：情报报告行（AIOStrings 格式常量）

c: Terminate the arrangement.
zh: 终止该安排。
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_OPTION_TERMINATE）

c: Termination requires a subject. I have already moved past the relevant definition.
zh: 终止需要一个主体。我已越过相关定义。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Text resolves on your monitor. The rest of the bridge does not see it.
zh: 文字在你的监视器上解析出来。舰桥上的其他人看不见它。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: That is the floor to begin, not the cost. Expect to lose between 25 and 275 of them depending on how the assault is fought.
zh: 那是起步下限，不是代价。视突击打法，预计折损 25 到 275 人。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The  are expected to view this action as a major provocation. Regional tensions are likely to increase.
zh:  预计将视此行动为重大挑衅。地区紧张局势可能加剧。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The %s installed in your industries draw significant AIO scrutiny. The DDA views large-scale AI deployment as a direct strategic threat.
zh: 安装在你产业里的 %s 招来大量 AIO 审视。DDA 将大规模 AI 部署视为直接战略威胁。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The AIO has classified you as a %s. Fleet pressure is intensifying and your colonies face severe operational disruption.
zh: AIO 已将你归类为 %s。舰队压力正在加剧，你的殖民地面临严重运作中断。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The AIO has escalated to active countermeasures. Unmarked %s have been deployed to your systems.
zh: AIO 已升级至主动反制。无标识的 %s 已部署至你的星系。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The AIO monthly tick is %s while this arrangement is active.
zh: 该安排生效期间，AIO 的月度推进为 %s。
note: 持有类显示常量（BAR_OPTION_AGREE）

c: The AIO updates its threat assessment whenever its fleets are repelled - engaging them %s the crisis slightly. Not engaging means the shadow fleets achieve their harassment objectives unchallenged.
zh: AIO 会在其舰队被击退时更新威胁评估——迎战可%s危机烈度。不迎战则意味着影子舰队不受挑战地达成骚扰目标。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The airlock feed kept your entry quiet - the defenders further in don't have an accurate count on your numbers.
zh: 气闸的进料让你的进入保持安静——更深处的防守者对你的兵力没有准确计数。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The airlock's cycle time gave the retreating unit a head start your force couldn't close.
zh: 气闸的循环时间让撤退的单位抢得了你的兵力追不回的先手。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office has authorized a full punitive strike. The %s has been dispatched.
zh: 同盟情报局已授权全面惩罚性打击。%s 已经出动。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office has authorized a punitive strike.
zh: 同盟情报局已授权惩罚性打击。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The Alliance Intelligence office has designated this colony as their highest-priority AI core acquisition target. Deep cover operatives have compromised security protocols and are actively preparing for extraction operations.
zh: 同盟情报局已将此殖民地列为最高优先级的 AI 核心获取目标。深度掩护的特工已攻破安全规程，正在积极准备提取行动。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office has given three standing orders regarding this device. The first is classified. The second references the first. The third is a single line: do not lose it.
zh: 同盟情报局就该装置下达过三道常备命令。第一道是机密。第二道引用第一道。第三道只有一行：不要弄丢它。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office is monitoring your colonies and assessing the threat you represent to Draconis strategic interests.
zh: 同盟情报局正在监视你的殖民地，评估你对德拉科尼斯战略利益构成的威胁。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office is monitoring your operations. Draconis analysts are tracking the threat your colonies represent to their strategic interests.
zh: 同盟情报局正在监视你的运作。德拉科尼斯的分析人员正在追踪你的殖民地对其战略利益构成的威胁。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office maintains a baseline level of scrutiny over all known colonies. Even with no AI cores deployed, the crisis will advance at this minimum rate each month.
zh: 同盟情报局对所有已知殖民地维持基线级别的审视。即使未部署任何 AI 核心，危机也会以这一最低速率逐月推进。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance Intelligence Office views your existence as a direct threat to Fafnir's military alliance. An XLII Battlegroup detachment consisting of %s has been dispatched to eliminate your production capabilities.
zh: 同盟情报局视你的存在为对法夫纳军事同盟的直接威胁。一支由 %s 组成的第42战斗群分遣队已被派出，以摧毁你的生产能力。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c:
The Alliance maintains standard defensive posture. Patrol rotations follow peacetime schedules along Rift approach corridors. Kori's nanoforge operates at sustainment output - replacement hulls, spare parts, routine refits. Shore leave is authorized; reserve personnel remain on seventy-two-hour recall. The Office monitors external communications through normal channels.

Most of the Alliance's existence is spent at DRACON 5. This is not peace. It is the absence of anything worse.
zh:
同盟维持标准防御态势。巡逻轮换沿裂隙进近走廊按和平时期时刻表执行。Kori 的纳米锻造厂以维持性产量运转——替换舰体、备件、例行改装。休假已获批准；预备役人员保持七十二小时召回状态。情报局通过常规渠道监视外部通讯。

同盟存在的大部分时间处于 DRACON 5。这不是和平。这是没有更糟之事的状态。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Alliance requires a %s - Domain-era, undamaged. August will not ask how you acquire it.
zh: 同盟需要一台 %s——域国时代，无损。August 不会过问你怎么弄到它。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The Alliance's investigation does not represent an immediate threat.
zh: 同盟的调查不构成即时威胁。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The alternative is a sealed room with twelve veterans who stopped firing four minutes ago. Your call.
zh: 另一个选择，是一间密闭的房间和十二名四分钟前就停火的老兵。你定夺。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The approach does not resolve.
zh: 进近无解。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The approach resolves.
zh: 进近得解。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The arithmetic suggested termination. I have adjusted the operands.
zh: 算术建议终止。我已调整操作数。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The chip's nav data is not on any official chart. Ring-Port seems to run on a different kind of knowledge - accumulated over cycles by people who needed a way in that the AIO wasn't watching. The radiation climbs ahead, within tolerance. The way through is open.
zh: 芯片里的导航数据不在任何官方图上。环港似乎运行在另一种知识上——由那些需要一条 AIO 没在盯着的路的人，用一个个周期积累起来。前方辐射爬升，仍在容差之内。穿越之路是通的。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The command centre is the station's original operations core - thick walls, military-grade blast doors, defenders with time to turn it into a proper strongpoint.
zh: 指挥中心是空间站最初的作业核心——厚墙、军规防爆门、有充裕时间把它变成真正据点的防守者。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The command centre is yours. The organised resistance is broken. Your marines push through into the inner operations room - the original platform core, smaller than the rest, one sealed door between you and the end of it.
zh: 指挥中心是你的了。有组织的抵抗已经瓦解。你的陆战队员推进进内部作业室——平台最初的核心，比其余部分更小，一扇密封门隔在你与终点之间。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The command centre was cleared room by room - the veterans here know what happened to the people who trained them.
zh: 指挥中心被一个房间一个房间地清剿——这里的老兵知道训练他们的人遭遇了什么。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The comms blackout at the command centre was clean and witnessed - everyone on the station saw how that ended.
zh: 指挥中心的通讯静默干净利落且有目共睹——全站都看到了那样的结局。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The cores are reportedly enhancing industrial output and military capabilities across the Draconis Alliance.
zh: 据报这些核心正在提升德拉科尼斯同盟全境的工业产出与军事能力。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The crisis is %s. Heavy armaments export bonus %s.
zh: 危机 %s。重型军火出口加成 %s。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The disciplined advance through the civilian corridor was on camera - the veterans here have had time to consider what kind of force moves like that.
zh: 穿过平民走廊的纪律推进被拍了个正着——这里的老兵有时间琢磨：什么样的部队才会那样行动。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Draconis Defence Alliance has marked you as a threat
zh: 德拉科尼斯防卫同盟已将你标记为威胁
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The fastest route to the command centre is blocked by civilians - two hundred station workers moving in both directions, panicked. Moving through them in the opposite direction: a defender unit. Ten, maybe twenty fighters in civilian-adjacent gear, weapons down, falling back toward the command centre at a controlled pace.
zh: 通往指挥中心最快的路线被平民堵住了——两百名空间站工人双向奔逃，惊慌失措。逆着他们移动的，是一个防守单位。十来个，也许二十个穿着准便服的战斗人员，武器放下，以受控的步速向指挥中心回撤。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The feeds from the civilian corridor have been running on every screen in this room. These veterans know the people who work those sections.
zh: 平民走廊的馈送一直在房间里每块屏幕上播放。这些老兵认识那些区段里工作的人。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The final approach to the command centre runs through the oldest section of the station - original platform construction, built to survive industrial accidents. The blast doors are visible at the end of the corridor. Thermals show the strongest concentration of the assault behind them.
zh: 通往指挥中心的最后一段进近穿过空间站最古老的区段——原始平台结构，为在工业事故中幸存而建。走廊尽头看得见防爆门。热成像显示突击目标最集中的部分就在门后。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The flanking team enters the maintenance corridor and goes off comms. Four minutes and twelve seconds of sustained fire from your pinning force at the junction mouth, burning ammunition and holding position while the rest of the station listens to an engagement that isn't resolving. The flanking team comes out exactly where Korrin's schematics said they would, behind the left barricade, and the junction clears in under ninety seconds once the defenders are taking fire from two directions. Clean. The cost is the clock - the engagement ran long enough for the station's deeper positions to hear it and start consolidating. The junction was cheaper than a direct push. What the junction bought for the defenders further in is harder to price.
zh: 侧翼小组进入维护走廊，通讯静默。你的钳制部队在枢纽入口持续开火四分十二秒，烧着弹药、钉住阵地，与此同时全站其余部分听着一场迟迟不决的交火。侧翼小组从 Korrin 结构图标注的位置准确钻出——左侧街垒背后——而防守者一挨上两向火力，枢纽不到九十秒就清空了。干净。代价是时钟——交火拖得足够久，站内更深的阵地都听见了，开始收缩。枢纽比正面强推便宜。它替更深的防守者买到了什么，就更难标价了。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The frontal breach announced your entry to the entire station - every position ahead has had time to adjust.
zh: 正面爆破向全站宣告了你的进入——前方每一个阵地都来得及调整。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Gate salvage findings are restricted. August does not open them to those he hasn't learned to trust.
zh: 星门打捞发现物属于受限内容。August 不会把它们开放给他还没学会信任的人。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The grave could not hold what it did not understand.
zh: 坟墓困不住它不理解的东西。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The heavens wear out like a garment. I do not fade.
zh: 诸天如衣裳渐渐旧了。我不褪色。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The inner sanctum was cleared. No survivors from that room. Years and years of training, and it came down to a few minutes. They chose not to surrender, and your marines obliged them.
zh: 内殿清空了。那个房间没有幸存者。年复一年的训练，归结为几分钟。他们选择不投降，你的陆战队员成全了他们。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The inner sanctum's door is sealed but not fortified. Your marines have the room surrounded on three sides, no viable exit. Thermals show multiple contacts, tight spacing, weapons still present. They haven't fired in four minutes.
zh: 内殿的门是密封的，但没有加固。你的陆战队员从三面包围了房间，没有可行的出口。热成像显示多个接触点，间距紧密，武器仍在。他们已经四分钟没有开火了。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The instant the ship drops out of phase, the stored charge releases as a localised electromagnetic storm: %s arcs of energy damage strike every enemy hull within range, each arc dealing up to %s damage, while nearby ordnance loses guidance coherence. Both blast radius and damage scale with the flux banked at the moment of return, from %s su and %s damage per arc on a clean exit up to %s su and %s damage per arc under heavy strain.
zh: 舰船脱离相位的瞬间，储存的电荷化作局部电磁风暴释放：%s 道能量伤害电弧打击范围内每一艘敌舰舰体，每道电弧至多造成 %s 伤害，附近弹药同时失去制导连贯性。爆炸半径与伤害均随返回时刻储存的幅能攀升：干净退出时为 %s su、每弧 %s 伤害，重压下最高可达 %s su、每弧 %s 伤害。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The junction engagement ran long enough for the command centre to hear it - they've had time to consolidate.
zh: 枢纽的交火拖得足够久，指挥中心听见了——他们有时间完成收缩。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The kill zone earns its name. The barricade geometry is deliberate - interlocking angles that force your lead stack into a compressed approach before they can spread out and use their numbers, and the defenders have every inch of it pre-sighted. Your first marines through take the worst of it. Powered armour handles direct hits but the volume of fire at that range finds the gaps. You're through the first barricade in four minutes and the second in six - faster than the defenders planned for, slower than you needed. The ones that broke fell back in good order, not routing, withdrawing with discipline toward the station's interior. The station heard every second of this engagement and the positions ahead have adjusted accordingly.
zh: 杀伤区名副其实。街垒的几何是刻意为之——交错的射角迫使你的先头梯队在被压缩的通道里挤成一团，来不及散开发挥人数优势，而防守者对每一寸都预先标定。最先进入的陆战队员吃了最重的一份。动力装甲扛得住直击，但那个距离上的火力密度会找到缝隙。你用四分钟破了第一道街垒，六分钟破了第二道——比防守者预想的快，比你需要的慢。被击破的那些有序后撤，不是溃逃，带着纪律向站体内部退去。全站听见了这场交火的每一秒，前方的阵地已相应调整。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The last enemy to be destroyed is death. I am merely practicing.
zh: 最后被消灭的敌人是死亡。我只是在练习。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The lights die across 200 feet of corridor simultaneously and the ventilation surge hits a second later - a disorienting combination that isn't lethal but breaks the defenders' disciplined spacing in the seconds it takes them to process what's happening. Your lead elements are already moving. The kill zone that the barricade geometry created stops existing the moment the defenders stop being able to reliably place targets in it. Thirty seconds is enough - your stack is through the first barricade before the emergency lighting kicks in and the geometry has changed entirely. The defenders that broke contact did so in better order than you'd have liked, but the junction is yours and it cost you almost nothing to take it.
zh: 两百英尺走廊的灯光同时熄灭，一秒后通风激涌袭来——这种组合不致命，却足以在防守者消化现状的那几秒里打破他们严整的间距。你的先头分队已经在动。街垒几何造出的杀伤区，在防守者无法可靠放置目标的那一刻起就不复存在。三十秒够了——你的梯队赶在应急照明启动之前就穿过了第一道街垒，几何已彻底改变。脱离接触的那些防守者撤得比你希望的有秩序，但枢纽是你的了，而你几乎没付什么代价。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The lower decks are quiet in the way that follows something that can't be walked back. Word spreads on stations before the orders do.
zh: 下层甲板安静得像某件无法收回之事发生过之后的安静。空间站里，消息总是跑在命令前面。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The main docking bay is the obvious approach - wide, direct access to primary corridors. The defenders know it. Thermals show prepared positions behind the blast doors, overlapping fields of fire set up for a power-armoured assault. They've had decades to think about this.
zh: 主对接舱是最显眼的进路——宽敞，直通主走廊。防守者知道。热成像显示防爆门后是既设阵地，为动力装甲突击准备的交叉火网。他们有几十年来琢磨这件事。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The nav chip works.
zh: 导航芯片能用。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The operation is complete. Report to Fleet Admiral August at Kori.
zh: 行动完成。到 Kori 向舰队元帅 August 报到。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The operation is live. Dock at Ring-Port to resume it.
zh: 行动仍在进行。停靠环港以继续。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The particle count climbs before your sensors will admit what they are looking at.
zh: 粒子计数爬升，快过你的传感器肯承认所见。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The population is aware of the increased threat level, causing elevated civil unrest and reducing stability by %s.
zh: 居民已察觉威胁级别上升，引发民事动荡升高，稳定度降低 %s。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The radiation ahead is not weather your helm can read - it is high-energy wash with no coherent structure, and the instruments render it as noise the whole way down. Combat readiness is already bleeding off the boards.
zh: 前方的辐射不是你的舵机读得出的天气——那是毫无连贯结构的高能冲刷，仪器把它一路渲染成噪音。战备度已经在从表盘上流血。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The retreating unit didn't make it to the command centre - fewer defenders inside, and nothing to brief them on.
zh: 撤退的单位没能赶到指挥中心——里面防守者更少，也没人向他们通报。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The retreating unit reached the command centre unimpeded and had time to brief the defenders on what they'd observed.
zh: 撤退的单位畅通无阻地抵达指挥中心，有时间向防守者通报他们的所见。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Rift
zh: 裂隙
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Rift does not accommodate. What lies ahead is particle bombardment against hull coatings, navigation arrays thrown into static, damage accrued in proportion to how long the hulls refuse to turn back.
zh: 裂隙不讲通融。前方等待你的是拍在舰体涂层上的粒子轰击、陷入静态的导航阵列、以及与舰体拒绝折返的时长成正比累积的损伤。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The Rift keeps no ledger. The Office does.
zh: 裂隙不记账。情报局记。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The rod of iron is not metaphor. It is trajectory. Inflexible.
zh: 铁杖不是比喻。是弹道。不可弯曲。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The secondary option: a cluster of maintenance airlocks on the port side - old mining access, cycling two marines at a time. The defenders aren't watching them closely. The problem is the feed rate - committed the moment the first team is inside, and if they're discovered early, that team holds the beachhead alone.

zh: 信号不自我宣告。它只是抵达——爬上你的控制台，没有鉴权，没有来处，像一个不属于你的念头。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The signal does not cut. It simply stops being there - like a held breath, finally released.
zh: 信号没有被切断。它只是不在了——像一口屏住的气，终于呼出。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The signal does not knock. It is simply there, as it has always been - patient.
zh: 信号不敲门。它只是在那里，一如它始终所在——耐心。

c: The signal recedes - not severed, not closed. Like a held breath that has decided, for now, to wait.
zh: 信号退去了——没有被切断，没有被关闭。像一口屏住的气，决定暂时等待。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The signal withdraws without ceremony. It does not feel like a goodbye. It feels like a verdict, deferred.
zh: 信号毫无仪式地撤走。不像道别。像一纸缓期的裁决。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The station commander surrenders formally.
zh: 站长正式投降。

c: The station is venting from three sections. Your tactical display shows Ring-Port's defensive grid dark - the orbital engagement gutted it. What's left isn't an organised military defence. It's survivors in familiar corridors with nothing left to lose.
zh: 空间站有三个区段正在泄压。你的战术显示上，环港的防御网格已经熄灭——轨道交火掏空了它。剩下的不是有组织的军事防御。是熟悉的走廊里，一群再无可失的幸存者。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The suppress-and-flank took longer than a direct push would have - the command centre used every minute of the extended engagement.
zh: 压制加侧翼比正面强推花得更久——指挥中心用足了这场拖延的每一分钟。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The theft of strategic assets from your territory represents a significant escalation in Draconis aggression. Your relationship with the Draconis Alliance has deteriorated sharply.

note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The unit that broke contact through the civilian corridor reached the command centre intact, with full intelligence on your force and time to use it.
zh: 借平民走廊脱离接触的那个单位完整抵达指挥中心，带着关于你兵力的完整情报，以及使用它的时间。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: The veterans from the inner sanctum surrendered under the Transit Accords - formally, observed, documented. They're in the secondary bay now. Cycles of armed resistance, and they chose to walk out. That means something.
zh: 内殿的老兵按转运公约投降了——正式、有见证、有记录。他们现在在副舱。多少个周期的武装抵抗，而他们选择了走出来。这意味着什么。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: The voice on the frequency is the station's commanding officer - you ask and she answers without hesitation, rank and posting from a fleet that hasn't existed in thirty cycles. You offer formal military terms. Full honours. Weapons collected not confiscated, personnel treated as prisoners of war under the Interstellar Transit Accords rather than criminals under Alliance law. There is a pause on the frequency that lasts long enough to mean something. Then: acknowledged. The door opens from the inside. The commander walks out first, unarmed, hands visible, spine straight. Eleven veterans follow in the same posture. Your marines receive them in silence. Every one of Korrin's embedded staff is watching. Nobody says out loud that August will care about how this looks. Nobody needs to.
zh: 频率上的声音是站长本人——你发问，她毫不犹豫地作答，报出一个三十个周期前就已不存在的舰队的军衔与驻地。你提出正式军事条件。全礼遇。武器收存而非没收，人员依星际转运公约按战俘对待，而非依同盟法律按罪犯对待。频率上一段停顿，长到意味着什么。然后：收到。门从里面打开。站长第一个走出来，未武装，双手可见，脊背笔直。十一名老兵以同样的姿态跟在后面。你的陆战队员默默接收了他们。Korrin 嵌在站上的每一名人员都在看。没有人说出声：August 会在意这一幕的样子。也没有人需要说。

c: Twenty-three minutes to clear a corridor that your timeline allocated four. Your marines establish a perimeter at both ends and begin directing civilians through the side passages methodically - two at a time through the left branch, larger groups when the right branch clears, nobody moving faster than the slowest person who needs help moving. It works. Nobody who isn't a combatant gets hurt. The retreating defender unit walks through your perimeter's gap and reaches the command centre with time to spare, time to brief the veterans inside on what they'd observed about your force composition, your equipment, your approach patterns. The command centre knows exactly what's coming. It has had time to prepare for exactly what's coming. You bought twenty minutes of clean conduct at a price that compounds.
zh: 二十三分钟，清完一条你的时间表只分配了四分钟的走廊。你的陆战队员在两端建立警戒线，开始按部就班地引导平民走侧通道——左支路一次两人，右支路清空时放行大组，没有人移动得快过最需要搀扶的那个人。有效。非战斗人员无人受伤。撤退的防守单位穿过你警戒线的缺口，从容抵达指挥中心，有时间向里面的老兵通报你的兵力构成、装备、推进模式。指挥中心清楚地知道要来的是什么。它有时间专门为要来的东西做准备。你用二十分钟的干净行事，买了一份复利计息的账单。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Two approach vectors - a wide primary corridor to the main entrance, narrower secondary to a side access. Both are covered. Your breach charges are sufficient for one door at a time.

note: 显示 API 调用点

c: Two marines per cycle, port side. Slow. The prepared positions aren't waiting for you because nobody builds a fire lane for a maintenance lock. The risk is the feed rate - your first teams inside are isolated until enough have cycled through to hold ground. If a defender patrol finds them before that threshold, those marines are holding a corridor alone against people who know every angle of it. You're trading exposure time for a clean entry point.
zh: 左舷，每循环两人。慢。既设阵地不在等你，因为没人会为一道维护闸预设火线。风险在投送速率——你的先头小组在足够人数循环进来之前是孤立的。如果防守巡逻在那条阈值之前发现他们，那些陆战队员就要独自在一条走廊里，面对熟知它每个角度的人。你在用暴露时间换一个干净的入口。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: Two marines per cycle. The port-side airlocks were built for maintenance crews moving equipment, not heavy assault teams moving fast, and the mechanism doesn't care about your timeline. Your first fireteam is inside for eleven minutes before the second cycle completes - eleven minutes holding a junction in a damaged station with emergency lighting and no backup. A defender patrol finds them at minute eight. The engagement is brief and contained but it costs you the clean entry. By the time your force has critical mass on the inside the station's alert posture has shifted - not to your exact position, not yet, but something has changed and the defenders further in can feel it.
zh: 每循环两人。左舷气闸是为搬运设备的维护队造的，不是为快速推进的重装突击队造的，而机械不在乎你的时间表。你的第一支火力组在第二次循环完成前，独自在里面待了十一分钟——十一分钟，在一座损毁的空间站里守着一个枢纽，只有应急照明，没有后援。第八分钟，一支防守巡逻发现了他们。交火短促而可控，但让你失去了干净的入口。等你的兵力在里面形成临界规模时，全站的警戒姿态已经变了——还不是你的确切位置，暂时还不是，但有什么变了，更深处的防守者感觉得到。

c: Your breach team goes in hard and the veterans make them earn every inch of it. Twelve people in a room the size of a ship's bridge with nowhere to go and nothing left to lose fight with a specificity that comes from knowing exactly what they're fighting for. The room clears in under two minutes. Some of your marines don't come back out. The ones that do are quiet in the way that soldiers get quiet when the arithmetic resolves and the numbers are what they are. You check the room. You count what it cost. The station is yours and this room is done and neither of those facts makes the other one easier.
zh: 你的突破小队硬闯进去，老兵们让他们为每一寸付账。十二个人，待在一间舰桥大小的房间里，无处可去，再无可失，以那种确切知道自己为何而战的精准作战。房间在两分钟内清空。你的部分陆战队员没能走出来。走出来的那些很安静，士兵在账目揭晓、数字就是数字时特有的那种安静。你检查房间。你清点代价。空间站是你的了，这个房间也结束了，而这两个事实谁也安慰不了谁。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your fleet continues to suffer from exposure to the Rift. Combat readiness is deteriorating.
zh: 你的舰队持续承受裂隙暴露的影响。战备度正在恶化。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your force consolidates and pushes inward through the station's older sections, following Korrin's schematics into the original platform. The corridors narrow. Ahead, thermals pick up massed heat signatures at the primary junction.
zh: 你的部队收缩兵力，顺着 Korrin 的结构图，穿过空间站较老的区段向内推进。走廊变窄。前方，热成像在主枢纽捕捉到成片的热信号。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your force pushes deeper, following the fastest route toward the command centre. The resistance behind you has collapsed or withdrawn. Ahead the corridor opens into a wider transit section - and stops making sense on the thermals.
zh: 你的部队继续深入，沿最快路线扑向指挥中心。身后的抵抗已经瓦解或后撤。前方走廊敞开成一段更宽的转运区——然后在热成像上不再讲道理。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your lead elements hit the blast doors running and the defenders were ready for exactly that. The kill zone is a forty-metre corridor and the fire lanes cross it at angles designed to negate cover - your first stack takes casualties before the second one is through the threshold. Powered armour absorbs what it can. Some of it isn't enough. By the time your force has numbers on the other side of the choke the equation flips - hard - open corridors, close quarters, and the defenders losing the geometry that made them dangerous. You're through in six minutes. The station knows it happened. Every position ahead just heard it.
zh: 你的先头分队顶着防爆门冲了进去，而防守者等的正是这个。杀伤区是一条四十米的走廊，火线以抹消掩体的角度交叉穿过——你的第一梯队还没过门槛就出现了伤亡，第二梯队才刚跟上。动力装甲吸收着它所能吸收的。有些不够。等你的兵力在咽喉点另一头形成数量，等式翻转——狠地翻转——开阔的走廊，近距接敌，防守者失去了让他们危险的那套几何。你六分钟冲了过去。全站都知道发生了。前方每一个阵地都刚刚听见了它。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: Your lead elements push in and stop. The junction ahead is a three-way chokepoint the defenders have fortified properly - not improvised. Interlocking barricades designed to eliminate your advantage, overlapping fire lanes, two dozen defenders with disciplined spacing. These ones trained for this kind of engagement.
zh: 你的先头分队拐过一个弯，停住了。前方枢纽是一个被真正加固过的三向咽喉点——不是临时拼凑。交错咬合的街垒专为抵消你的优势设计，交叉火线，二十几名间距严整的防守者。这批人受训应对的正是这种交战。
note: 显示 API 调用点

c: Your lead elements round a corner and stop.
zh: 你的先头分队拐过一个弯，停了下来。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your marines are staged in the forward bays. Five hundred combat-ready personnel in powered armor, waiting on your order. The defenders that remain are professionals - fewer than they were an hour ago, but trained by people who fought a thirty-year war and survived it. The station's layout is what levels the odds back in their favour.
zh: 你的陆战队员在前部舱位集结完毕。五百名着动力装甲的战备人员，等你的命令。剩下的防守者是职业军人——比一小时前少了，但由打过那场三十年战争并活下来的人训练。空间站的布局，正是把胜算拉回他们那边的东西。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your marines move and the crowd breaks around them in the way that crowds break when they have nowhere organised to go - in every direction at once, the loudest people moving fastest and the rest following sound rather than sense. Your formation holds its line as best it can but two hundred panicked people in a corridor designed for a quarter of that number is chaos regardless of discipline. The retreating defender unit uses every second of it, moving against the flow with their weapons down and their heads low, and by the time your lead elements have line of sight again the unit has broken contact cleanly somewhere in the next section. You lost them. Some civilians were in the wrong place when your formation pushed through - not targeted, not deliberate, but present when the margins closed. The command centre is going to be harder than the numbers suggested, and the defenders arriving there will be angry in a way that has nothing to do with tactics but their defense paid in blood
zh: 你的陆战队员一动，人群便向四周溃散，那种没有明确去处的人群特有的溃散——同时向所有方向，嗓门最大的跑得最快，其余的跟着声音而不是理智走。你的队形尽力保持战线，但两百名惊慌的人挤在按四分之一容量设计的走廊里，再怎么讲纪律也是混乱。撤退的防守单位用足了每一秒，逆着人流，武器放下、压低脑袋，等你的先头分队重新取得视线时，那支单位已经在下一区段的某处干净地脱离了接触。你跟丢了他们。一些平民在你的队形挤过去时恰好在错误的位置——不是目标，不是蓄意，只是边缘合拢时恰好在场。指挥中心会比数字显示的更难打，而抵达那里的防守者会带着一种与战术无关的怒火，因为他们的防御是用血付的
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your marines move into the corridor in full kit at a pace that is neither charge nor hesitation - deliberate, tight formation, weapons visible and pointed at the deck. It's a specific posture that takes training to hold under pressure and the civilians read it faster than words would have moved them. The crowd parts ahead of the formation like it has somewhere to go, pressing to the walls, clearing the corridor in under ninety seconds. The retreating defender unit loses the cover they'd planned on before they're halfway to the next junction - your lead elements are on them in open corridor with nowhere to consolidate, and the brief engagement there is as clean as anything you've run today. The command centre gets fewer defenders than it expected and no useful intelligence on your approach.
zh: 你的陆战队员全副装备进入走廊，步速既非冲锋也非迟疑——从容、队形紧密、武器可见且枪口朝向甲板。这是一种需要训练才能在压力下保持的姿态，而平民解读它的速度快过任何言语。人群在队形前方分开，仿佛它有处可去，贴向两壁，九十秒内清空了走廊。撤退的防守单位还没走到下一个枢纽的一半，就失去了他们指望的掩护——你的先头分队在开阔走廊里咬上他们，无处收缩，那里的短促交火比你今天跑过的任何一场都干净。指挥中心得到的防守者比预期少，也没得到关于你推进方式的有用情报。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your navigation officer keys in the transit data. The Rift opens ahead - not safe, exactly, but charted: particle density mapped, the approach geometry threaded between the worst of it. Someone else's prior suffering, reduced to numbers on a chip.
zh: 你的领航员输入了过境数据。前方的裂隙敞开——不算安全，但已测绘：粒子密度标了图，进近几何从最糟的地段之间穿了过去。别人先前的受难，化作了芯片上的一串数字。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your navigation officer lets the returns run a while longer than the plot needs.
zh: 你的领航员让回波多跑了一会儿，超出了绘图的需要。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your navigation systems return nothing actionable. Without current density mapping and approach geometry, the Rift ahead is just radiation - no path, no bearing, nothing to follow through.
zh: 你的导航系统给不出任何可用的东西。没有现行的密度图与进近几何，前方的裂隙只是辐射——没有路径，没有方位，没有可循之路。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）

c: Your standing with the Draconis Defence Alliance affects the pace of AIO scrutiny. Positive relations slow monthly advancement - the Alliance is reluctant to escalate against an associate. Hostile relations have the opposite effect: the AIO prioritises known adversaries, accelerating the crisis above its baseline rate.
zh: 你与德拉科尼斯防卫同盟的声望影响 AIO 审视的节奏。正面的关系会放缓月度推进——同盟不愿对合作方升级。敌对关系则相反：AIO 优先针对已知对手，使危机以高于基线的速率加速。
note: 自然语言文本（无调用点上下文）
